title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E8 — Jerry Butler
Singer Jerry Butler headlines this episode, together with his back-up group, Peaches.  Highlights of their numbers are "Make It Easy on Yourself" and "Brand New Me".

title: Webster
description:
S1 E1 — Another Ballgame
After the untimely death of a young boy's parents, he is sent to live with his father's best friend.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E3 — Kathryn's Swan Song
Katherine wants to get some attention from Webster and she tries a few things. Meanwhile, Webster's friend is not getting much attention because her mom just had a baby, so she runs away and Webster hides her in his room.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E4 — Consulting Adults
Webster tries out for the football team. Katherine is then afraid that Webster will get seriously hurt especially because of his height and build. Also, we learn that Webster is picked to be on the team only because of George's fame in football.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E5 — Travis
It is revealed to George and Katherine why Travis, Webster's late father, chose George to be Webster's godparents and legal guardians if something happened to them.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E9 — Don't Jump George
Katherine is too obsessed with winning when she appears on a game show.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E12 — Mixed Doubles
It's a game of musical dates as the girls' family and friends switch partners for a night on the town.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E13 — Two Guys, A Girl, and a Calendar
Tia and Tamera battle it out on behalf of their guys as competition gets tight for a spot in their school's 12 Most Gorgeous Men on Campus calendar.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E14 — Sweet Talk
Tamera lands a job as a radio talk show hostess dispensing advice on love on romance, including her own sister Tia's -- but without Tia's permission!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E15 — Father's Day
The twins think a photojournalist visiting campus may be their biological father.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E16 — I Know What You Did In Drama Class
Diavian and Tyreke become partners in drama class but Tia flips out after catching them in a passionate kiss during a drama rehearsal. Tamera and Jordan try to hook up cable in the girl's room.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E1 — Labor Day Jammy
Mo’s new school’s annual fund-raiser conflicts with Crenshaw High’s final summer blowout “Freaknik”, and Frank and Dee insist Mo should attend the fund-raiser.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E2 — (Grand)Poppa Don’t Take No Mess
Moesha tries to get sympathy from her visiting grandfather over having to go to a new school.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E3 — Day One
Mo attends the first day at her new school and is miserable.  She has only made one friend and feels out of place.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E4 — Age Ain't Nothin' But a Number
Hakeem begins to date an older woman he meets at his store.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E5 — My Mom’s Not An Ottoman
Dee wins a free decorating consultation at Mo’s school raffle and can’t wait to redo the house.

S3 E11 — Mistaken Identity
Mayhem and murder plague 227 when a mysterious man with a knife rents an apartment in Mary's building.

S3 E12 — Country Cousins
When Mary and Lester go to the reading of his uncle's will, they are both surprised to learn they have distant cousins whom they've never met, and even more confused when they discover they are a different color.

S3 E13 — Shall We Dance
When Lester's old high school sweetheart comes to the neighborhood in search of a new home, Mary fears that she'll try to move in on more than just her turf.

S3 E14 — Snowbound
Suffering from a very cold winter spell, the residents of '227' invade Mary and Lester's apartment, which is one of two apartments with heat.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E17 — Bachelor Daze
A friend's upcoming wedding cause Malcolm and Eddie to reexamine their feelings about the women in their own lives.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E18 — Mixed Nuts
A surprise birthday party for Malcolm's dad sets the Shermans and McGees to fighting.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E19 — The Slender Arm Of The Law
Eddie tries to help out the retired race car driver who helped get his first job.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E20 — A Few So-So Men
Malcolm unwittingly hires Eddie's longtime enemy to install a new bar at McGee's.
